messages:
Ana: Hey folks — planning Q2 customer enablement office hours for our highest-touch renewal cohort (Acme, BrightPath, NovaHealth). Proposed slots next week:
- Tue 10:00–11:00 PDT
- Wed 15:00–16:00 PDT
- Fri 09:00–10:00 PDT

Agenda draft: quick onboarding status, migration blockers, billing/RBAC questions, known issues + mitigations, 15-min live prompt-tuning demo. Who can lead the demo? Also need a short slide deck and canonical calendar invite text. @Priya can you ping Acme about Wed? :calendar:

Mike: I can run the demo but prefer Tue or Fri. Fri morning is best for me. I can prep a 12-min demo + 3 slides on common tuning patterns.

Devon: Ill own the slide deck and the signup form. Adding "known issues and mitigations" to agenda now. Can we ask customers to upload 1 sample prompt they want tuned before the session?

Priya: Confirmed with Acme — they prefer Wed 3pm PT. NovaHealth prefers Tue. BrightPath asked to avoid Fri mornings.

Ana: Hmm — looks like preferences conflict. Two options: 1) run a vendor-specific invite for Acme on Wed 3pm PT + an open office hours on Fri 9am PT for others, or 2) run two back-to-back office hours (Tue & Wed) to accommodate. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Mike: Option 1 sounds simpler operationally. I can tailor the Wed session to Acmes integration questions and keep Fri as a general Q&A + short demo. :thumbsup:

Devon: Agree. Ill create two calendar events: Acme (Wed 3pm PT, invite to Acme + internal Cs/SEs) and Public office hours (Fri 9am PT). Will add a Google Form for RSVPs and a single slide with session goals.

Ana: Great. Can you also paste the canonical invite blurb here so we can get it out to accounts?

Devon: Sure — draft invite below:

```
Subject: Redwood Enablement — Q2 Office Hours (Acme)
When: Wed, May 14 • 3:00–4:00 PM PT
Who: Acme + Redwood CS/SEs
Agenda:
- 10m: Onboarding status & next milestones
- 10m: Migration/blockers review
- 15m: Live prompt-tuning demo (Mike)
- 20m: Open Q&A, action items
Please attach one example prompt or use-case you'd like us to try during the demo. Zoom link will be in the calendar invite.
```

Devon: RSVP form: https://forms.gle/example-rsvp (I'll replace with real link).

enablement-bot: Calendar event created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 (Acme session). Invite sent to: ana@redwood.com, mike@redwood.com, priya@redwood.com, acme-eng@example.com

Priya: Sending to Acme now. I'll BCC BrightPath and NovaHealth about the Fri open office hours and ask for any questions they want covered.

Ana: Two quick asks before we close this thread:
1) Mike — can you confirm 10–12 slide deck by Tue EOD so Devon can extract 3 slides for the customer-facing deck?
2) Devon — add a short pre-read link and the sample-prompt collection field to the RSVP form.

Mike: Will do — deck uploaded to drive by Tue 5pm PT.

Devon: Done — added pre-read and prompt upload field. Ill post the final calendar links in #customer-updates once invites go out.

Ana: Awesome. Thanks team. Closing — will follow up with a quick post-session survey for feedback and renewal risk flags. :white_check_mark:
